message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "Resolve Ambiguous Classification via Morphological Report", "description": "When the chest X-ray classifier returns empty or low-confidence findings, invoke the report generator to extract descriptive anatomical evidence for diagnosis.", "applicable_conditions": "Applies when automated classification tools fail to provide specific pathological labels or return low confidence scores for chest imaging tasks.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "medium", "core_action": "If `chest_xray_classifier` returns empty `strong_findings` or indicates low confidence: (1) Do not attempt to infer pathology from quantitative scores alone; (2) Immediately invoke `chest_xray_report_generator` to obtain detailed morphological descriptions (e.g., volume loss, diaphragm position, opacity patterns); (3) Use these explicit anatomical descriptors to resolve diagnostic ambiguity and form a clinical impression."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
